paragraphs.text: Inniaz the Gale Force is a legendary female djinn from the plane of Dominaria , whose power comes from storms.

The wishes she grants come with an additional, equivalent cost. For example, a wish for extended life might cost the lifespan of a loved one; treasures and gold may cost an irreplaceable sentimental item. For this reason, one has to wish carefully, because a djinn's magic cannot be undone.
